definitions.gloss: trash bag; garbage bag; rubbish bag
definitions.explanation: A bag used for collecting and disposing of garbage. In many Japanese municipalities, designated bags must be purchased and used for trash collection.

examples.japanese: ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}を{買|か}ってきて。
ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}がいっぱいになった。
この{地域|ちいき}では{指定|してい}のごみ{袋|ぶくろ}を{使|つか}わなければならない。
examples.english: In this area, you have to use the designated trash bags.

examples.japanese: {燃|も}えるごみと{燃|も}えないごみで{別々|べつべつ}のごみ{袋|ぶくろ}に{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put burnable and non-burnable garbage in separate trash bags.

notes:
Compound of ごみ (garbage/trash) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). In Japan, many municipalities require residents to purchase designated trash bags ({指定|してい}ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}) sold at convenience stores and supermarkets. These bags are often color-coded by trash type (burnable, non-burnable, recyclable).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指定|してい}ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}: designated trash bag
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}に{入|い}れる: to put in a trash bag
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}を{出|だ}す: to put out a trash bag (for collection)
- ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}を{縛|しば}る: to tie up a trash bag

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's strict garbage separation system means households typically keep multiple types of ごみ{袋|ぶくろ}. The rules vary by municipality and are a common topic of daily life, especially for newcomers.

RELATED WORDS:
- ごみ{箱|ばこ}: trash can; wastebasket
- ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}: garbage collection
- {分別|ぶんべつ}: sorting; separation (of garbage)
